mission.title: Why we built this site
mission.p1: Knowledge sharing and demos for the AI data center (AI DC) domain, helping readers quickly grasp key concepts and formulas.

codeVolume.title: Codebase size
codeVolume.intro: Counts all source files in this repository (HTML, JavaScript, Shell, SVG, etc.), excluding binary assets such as PDFs and the .git directory.
codeVolume.statLinesNote: If all source were fed as a single prompt: 1,002,372 characters ÷ 2.5 chars/token, roughly 334K–501K.
codeVolume.langHtmlNote: 22 page files (home, inference basics, inference data flow, Agentic inference, post-training, AI DC design, room layout, 3D cases, ROI, About, etc.)
codeVolume.langJsNote: 23 scripts (i18n, page logic, config loader, locale bridge, etc.)
codeVolume.langShellNote: 6 scripts (local preview, deploy, API startup, verification, etc.)

usage.title: AI token consumption
usage.intro: Tracks token usage for the AIDC 2026 site in AI-assisted tools such as Cursor. Data comes from Included Usage CSV exports, summarized per billing cycle; re-importing merges increments by event date. Shown as input (cache miss), input (cache hit), and output.
usage.note: Per-period tokens are snapshots of Included Usage for that cycle; do not sum across periods. Refer to the Cursor console billing as source of truth. Older periods without field-level detail are split by recent measured ratios.

openSource.title: Open-source repository
openSource.p1: The full site source lives on GitHub and is updated with each release. See the live site entry below for the current version and date.
openSource.summary: This site supports research and learning in the AI data center (AI DC) domain. Source code is open for reference — fork and adapt as needed.
openSource.repoNote: Opens GitHub in a new tab. Issues and pull requests are welcome.
